name: session_read
description: Read another session's context (read-only). Default digest mode shows a header (title, first prompt, message count, checkpoints) plus messages; raw mode renders messages only, adding a 'reasoning:' line when the message carries model reasoning (runtime bookkeeping notes are not shown as reasoning). Sessions are identified by their id from session_list.
first_use_guidance:
Guidance for later session_read calls in this turn:
- The result does not report the page's index range; `from: 0` reads the oldest page.

session_id.description: Session id (from session_list), 1-128 ASCII letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

mode.description: digest (default): header + recent messages; raw: messages only.

limit.description: Number of messages to show: the most recent ones when `from` is omitted, or the page size forward from `from` when it is given (default 20 for digest, 60 for raw; max 200; 0 shows none).

from.description: Canonical message index (0-based, oldest first) to start reading from, paging forward by `limit`. Errors when out of range.
